content.text: A single continuous fifteen-second historical live-action close shot. Only the linen-sleeved hands, rough wooden desk and aged paper from the first frame. The camera stays very low and oblique, seeing the plain reverse of the paper held toward an unseen reader; the written side always faces away from the camera. From 0 to 5 seconds, the hands gently unroll the remaining curled ends and settle the sheet. From 5 to 12 seconds, the hands hold it steady while the camera glides slightly along its worn lower edge and backlit fibres. From 12 to 15 seconds, the right hand lifts one near corner, turns one sheet away toward the reader, then settles beside the paper. Preserve two normal hands and physical contact. The reverse remains plain fibrous paper. Only paper rustle, cloth and quiet room ambience, no voices or music.
